source_text: 物资集散中心已在灾区外围建立，用于统一接收和分配援助物资。
target_text: A logistics distribution hub has been established on the outskirts of the disaster zone for the centralised receipt and distribution of relief supplies.

source_text: 救援队伍已完成第一阶段搜救任务，正向第二作业区转移。
target_text: The rescue team has completed the first phase of SAR operations and is relocating to the second operational sector.

source_text: 应急响应协调员正在与地方政府官员进行联络，以掌握最新灾情动态。
target_text: The emergency response coordinator is liaising with local government officials to obtain the latest disaster situation updates.

source_text: 灾区道路经过紧急抢修已部分恢复通行，重型救援车辆可通过。
target_text: Disaster area roads have been partially restored following emergency repairs, allowing heavy rescue vehicles to pass.

source_text: 心理援助小组正在为亲历灾难的幸存者提供创伤后应激障碍评估与干预。
target_text: The psychological support team is providing post-traumatic stress disorder assessment and intervention for disaster survivors.

source_text: 紧急供水设备已运抵灾区，每日可为5000名受灾群众提供安全饮用水。
target_text: Emergency water supply equipment has arrived in the disaster area and can provide safe drinking water for 5,000 victims daily.

source_text: 所有参与救援的国际队伍须向联合国驻地协调员办公室进行注册登记。
target_text: All international teams participating in relief operations must register with the UN Resident Coordinator's Office.

source_text: 应急通信系统已建立冗余备份，确保指挥链在极端情况下保持畅通。
target_text: The emergency communications system has established redundant backups to ensure the command chain remains operational under extreme conditions.

source_text: 救灾行动结束后，所有参与单位须提交行动总结报告及经验教训。
target_text: After disaster relief operations conclude, all participating units must submit an after-action report and lessons learned.

source_text: 联合评估小组已完成对受灾社区的快速需求评估，结果将指导下一阶段救援。
target_text: The joint assessment team has completed a rapid needs assessment of the affected communities; the results will guide the next phase of relief.

source_text: 多功能应急救援车辆已前置部署至灾区入口，随时准备执行各类救援任务。
target_text: Multi-function emergency rescue vehicles have been forward-deployed to the disaster zone entrance, ready to execute various rescue tasks at any time.

source_text: 受灾地区的粮食安全形势严峻，需在48小时内完成第一批粮食发放。
target_text: The food security situation in the disaster area is critical; the first round of food distribution must be completed within 48 hours.

source_text: 救援行动的后勤支援链须确保物资从集散中心到最终受益人全程可追溯。
target_text: The logistics support chain for relief operations must ensure full traceability of supplies from the distribution hub to the final beneficiaries.

source_text: 减灾署已发布橙色预警，要求沿海地区居民立即启动防台风应急预案。
target_text: The disaster reduction agency has issued an orange alert, requiring coastal residents to immediately activate typhoon emergency response plans.

source_text: 现场安全官员须对每个救援作业区进行动态风险评估，及时发布安全预警。
target_text: On-site safety officers must conduct dynamic risk assessments for each rescue operations sector and issue safety warnings in a timely manner.

source_text: 医疗后送协议规定，重症伤员须在黄金一小时内转运至具备手术能力的医疗机构。
target_text: The medical evacuation protocol stipulates that critically injured casualties must be transferred to a surgical-capable medical facility within the golden hour.

source_text: 多国救援力量的行动协调须通过统一的作战协调中心进行，避免重复和遗漏。
target_text: Operational coordination among multinational relief forces must be conducted through a unified operations coordination centre to avoid duplication and gaps.

source_text: 灾区安置点的管理工作应遵循Sphere人道主义标准，确保受灾群众的基本权利。
target_text: Management of displacement sites in the disaster area should adhere to Sphere humanitarian standards to ensure the basic rights of affected persons.

source_text: 各救援队伍须按时向联合指挥部提交态势报告，内容包括任务完成情况和资源需求。
target_text: All rescue teams must submit situational reports to the joint command on schedule, covering mission completion status and resource requirements.

source_text: 救援物资的优先分配顺序为：医疗用品、饮用水、食品、庇护材料。
target_text: The priority distribution order for relief supplies is: medical supplies, potable water, food, and shelter materials.

source_text: 应急指挥系统采用模块化结构，可根据灾情规模灵活扩展指挥能力。
target_text: The incident command system adopts a modular structure that allows flexible expansion of command capabilities based on disaster scale.

source_text: 灾后重建阶段须同时兼顾基础设施恢复与受灾社区心理重建工作。
target_text: The post-disaster reconstruction phase must simultaneously address infrastructure restoration and psychological rehabilitation of affected communities.

source_text: 卫星图像分析显示洪水面积已超过200平方公里，持续扩大中。
target_text: Satellite image analysis shows the flooded area has exceeded 200 square kilometres and continues to expand.

source_text: 人道主义协调员正在召集各方代表参加紧急协调会议，商讨下一步救援部署。
target_text: The humanitarian coordinator is convening representatives from all parties for an emergency coordination meeting to discuss the next relief deployment.

source_text: 受损桥梁的临时修复工作由工兵部队负责，预计48小时内完工并恢复通行。
target_text: Temporary repair of the damaged bridge is the responsibility of the engineer corps; it is expected to be completed and restored to traffic within 48 hours.

source_text: 特种搜救队已部署至山体滑坡现场，利用热成像设备搜寻被掩埋的幸存者。
target_text: The specialist search and rescue team has been deployed to the landslide site, using thermal imaging equipment to search for buried survivors.

source_text: 医疗急救站已在灾区主要入口点设立，为前往灾区的救援人员提供医疗支援。
target_text: Medical first-aid stations have been established at major entry points to the disaster zone to provide medical support to relief personnel heading in.

source_text: 联合后勤协调中心负责统筹所有救援物资的接收、储存和配发工作。
target_text: The joint logistics coordination centre is responsible for coordinating the receipt, storage, and distribution of all relief supplies.

source_text: 紧急状态委员会决定将应急响应级别由三级提升至一级，动员更多资源投入救灾。
target_text: The emergency state committee has decided to upgrade the emergency response level from Level 3 to Level 1, mobilising more resources for disaster relief.

source_text: 国际人道主义法要求所有冲突各方必须为平民提供人道主义援助通道。
target_text: International humanitarian law requires all parties to a conflict to provide humanitarian aid corridors for civilians.

source_text: 灾区电力系统已完全中断，需紧急部署发电机组维持救援行动的基本用电需求。
target_text: The power system in the disaster area has completely failed; generator sets need to be urgently deployed to maintain basic electricity needs for relief operations.

source_text: 野外搜索队须遵循网格搜索方法，确保对指定搜索区域进行系统全面的覆盖。
target_text: Field search teams must follow the grid search method to ensure systematic and comprehensive coverage of the designated search area.

source_text: 对口支援省份已调拨500顶帐篷和2000套家庭应急包，正在运往灾区途中。
target_text: The counterpart support province has allocated 500 tents and 2,000 family emergency kits, which are currently en route to the disaster area.

source_text: 战略空运资产已被调配，将在未来12小时内向灾区运送大批紧急救援物资。
target_text: Strategic airlift assets have been allocated and will transport large quantities of emergency relief supplies to the disaster area within the next 12 hours.

source_text: 救援行动的指挥控制体系须建立清晰的责任链，明确各级指挥官的权责范围。
target_text: The command and control structure for relief operations must establish a clear chain of accountability, defining the responsibilities of commanders at each level.

source_text: 受灾群众注册系统已建立，以确保援助物资能够准确发放至有需要的家庭。
target_text: A victim registration system has been established to ensure relief supplies are accurately distributed to households in need.

source_text: 应急救援行动须遵循人道、中立、公正和独立四项核心人道主义原则。
target_text: Emergency relief operations must adhere to the four core humanitarian principles: humanity, neutrality, impartiality, and independence.

source_text: 联合国驻地协调员办公室正在协调制定统一的人道主义响应计划。
target_text: The UN Resident Coordinator's Office is coordinating the development of a unified humanitarian response plan.

source_text: 救灾资金缺口已超过预算的40%，紧急呼吁国际社会加大援助力度。
target_text: The disaster relief funding gap has exceeded 40% of the budget; an urgent appeal has been made to the international community to increase assistance.

source_text: 气象部门预报未来72小时内将有强降雨，可能引发次生洪涝灾害，请提前部署防范。
target_text: The meteorological department forecasts heavy rainfall within the next 72 hours, which may trigger secondary flooding; advance preventive deployment is requested.

source_text: 所有一线救援人员须接种破伤风和甲肝疫苗，并配备个人防护装备再进入灾区。
target_text: All frontline relief personnel must receive tetanus and hepatitis A vaccinations and be equipped with personal protective equipment before entering the disaster area.

source_text: 受灾人口数量估计已达15万人，其中约3万人属于需要特别关注的脆弱群体。
target_text: The estimated disaster-affected population has reached 150,000 people, of whom approximately 30,000 are vulnerable groups requiring special attention.

source_text: 国家应急管理局已启动国家级应急预案，协调军地各方力量共同参与救灾。
target_text: The National Emergency Management Authority has activated the national emergency plan, coordinating military and civilian forces to jointly participate in disaster relief.

source_text: 现场指挥部须确保每个搜救作业区均有通信联络员驻守，保证信息实时上报。
target_text: The on-site command post must ensure that a communications liaison officer is stationed in each SAR operations sector to guarantee real-time information reporting.

source_text: 医疗队须对安置点内的受灾群众进行定期巡诊，重点关注老人、儿童和孕妇的健康状况。
target_text: Medical teams must conduct regular medical rounds among disaster victims at settlement points, focusing on the health of the elderly, children, and pregnant women.

source_text: 救援物资的透明分配机制须建立，确保受灾群众了解其权利并可举报分配不公现象。
target_text: A transparent relief distribution mechanism must be established to ensure disaster victims understand their entitlements and can report unfair distribution.

source_text: Pasukan penyelamat telah menggunakan alat pengesan hidup untuk mencari mangsa di bawah runtuhan.
target_text: The rescue team has used life detection equipment to search for victims beneath the rubble.

source_text: Operasi pemindahan kecemasan bagi pesakit hospital sedang dijalankan akibat ancaman banjir.
target_text: Emergency evacuation operations for hospital patients are underway due to the flood threat.

source_text: Pasukan logistik sedang menyusun pelan pengagihan bekalan berdasarkan peta kawasan terlibat.
target_text: The logistics team is drawing up a supply distribution plan based on the map of affected areas.

source_text: Taklimat media harian diadakan oleh jurucakap NADMA untuk memaklumkan perkembangan terkini.
target_text: Daily media briefings are conducted by the NADMA spokesperson to communicate the latest developments.

source_text: Pasukan perubatan lapangan sedang mengendalikan kes kecemasan di hospital medan yang didirikan.
target_text: The field medical team is managing emergency cases at the established field hospital.

source_text: 联合搜救行动已覆盖灾区90%的区域，剩余区域将于明日完成搜索。
target_text: The joint SAR operation has covered 90% of the disaster area; the remaining area will be searched tomorrow.

source_text: 应急物资仓库已提前预置于灾害高风险区域周边，以缩短响应时间。
target_text: Emergency supply warehouses have been pre-positioned near high-risk disaster areas to reduce response time.

source_text: 救援人员在执行任务前须完成风险告知并签署相关安全协议。
target_text: Relief personnel must complete risk notification and sign relevant safety protocols before executing missions.

source_text: 受灾地区的学校将作为临时安置点使用，政府将为学生提供替代教育安排。
target_text: Schools in the affected area will be used as temporary shelters; the government will provide alternative educational arrangements for students.

source_text: 救灾行动进入第三天，各救援队伍须重新评估资源状况并提交补给申请。
target_text: Disaster relief operations have entered their third day; all rescue teams must reassess resource status and submit resupply requests.

source_text: Bantuan perubatan daripada negara-negara sahabat sedang diproses melalui Pusat Koordinasi AHA.
target_text: Medical assistance from friendly nations is being processed through the AHA Centre Coordination Hub.

source_text: Pasukan penilai awal mendapati kerosakan infrastruktur kritikal di tiga daerah yang terjejas.
target_text: The initial assessment team found critical infrastructure damage in three affected districts.

source_text: 医疗队报告灾区出现腹泻和皮肤病病例，需立即加强公共卫生干预措施。
target_text: The medical team reports cases of diarrhoea and skin disease in the disaster area; public health intervention measures must be strengthened immediately.

source_text: 人道主义援助物资的海关清关工作须在抵达后24小时内完成，以避免延误救援。
target_text: Customs clearance of humanitarian aid supplies must be completed within 24 hours of arrival to avoid delays in relief.

source_text: Kem pemindahan sementara sedang didirikan di kawasan tinggi untuk menampung penduduk terpindah.
target_text: Temporary evacuation camps are being established in elevated areas to accommodate displaced residents.

source_text: 灾区儿童心理援助计划已启动，专业心理咨询师将进驻各主要安置点开展工作。
target_text: A psychological support programme for children in the disaster area has been launched; professional counsellors will be stationed at major shelter sites.

source_text: Anggota sukarelawan yang hadir di kawasan bencana perlu didaftarkan dan diberikan taklimat keselamatan.
target_text: Volunteer personnel present in the disaster area must be registered and given a safety briefing.

source_text: 救援队伍的轮换制度已建立，确保一线人员在持续救援行动中保持体能和精神状态。
target_text: A rotation system for rescue teams has been established to ensure frontline personnel maintain physical and mental fitness during sustained relief operations.

source_text: Operasi pemantauan pasca bencana akan dijalankan selama 30 hari selepas fasa tindak balas selesai.
target_text: Post-disaster monitoring operations will be conducted for 30 days following the completion of the response phase.

source_text: Pasukan USAR sedang menggunakan kamera serat optik untuk mencari mangsa di celah-celah runtuhan.
target_text: The USAR team is using fibre optic cameras to locate victims in gaps within the rubble.

source_text: Perintah kawalan pergerakan telah dikeluarkan bagi mengawal kemasukan orang awam ke kawasan bencana.
target_text: A movement control order has been issued to restrict civilian access to the disaster area.

source_text: Sistem pengurusan insiden bersepadu telah diaktifkan untuk menyelaraskan semua operasi bantuan.
target_text: The integrated incident management system has been activated to coordinate all relief operations.

source_text: Pasukan perubatan telah mengesan kes leptospirosis di kalangan mangsa banjir dan langkah pencegahan diambil.
target_text: The medical team has detected leptospirosis cases among flood victims and preventive measures have been taken.

source_text: Helikopter Nuri sedang digunakan untuk menghantar bekalan ke kawasan pedalaman yang terputus hubungan.
target_text: Nuri helicopters are being used to deliver supplies to inland areas that have been cut off.

source_text: Pasukan gerak balas awal telah tiba di kawasan bencana dan sedang menjalankan penilaian situasi.
target_text: The early response team has arrived at the disaster area and is conducting a situation assessment.

source_text: Keperluan air bersih di kem pemindahan telah diatasi melalui pemasangan tangki air bergerak.
target_text: The need for clean water at the evacuation camp has been addressed through the installation of mobile water tanks.

source_text: Semua operasi cari dan selamat mesti dihentikan semasa amaran ribut petir dikeluarkan.
target_text: All search and rescue operations must be halted when a thunderstorm warning is issued.

source_text: Pasukan kejuruteraan sedang menilai kestabilan struktur bangunan sebelum membenarkan masuk.
target_text: The engineering team is assessing the structural stability of the building before permitting entry.

source_text: Bantuan makanan tambahan daripada agensi PBB telah tiba dan sedang diagihkan kepada mangsa.
target_text: Supplementary food assistance from UN agencies has arrived and is being distributed to victims.

source_text: Prosedur kawalan jangkitan sedang dilaksanakan di semua kemudahan perubatan lapangan.
target_text: Infection control procedures are being implemented at all field medical facilities.

source_text: Pasukan komunikasi telah memasang menara relay sementara untuk memulihkan liputan rangkaian.
target_text: The communications team has installed a temporary relay tower to restore network coverage.

source_text: Operasi bantuan udara telah berjaya menghantarkan 10 tan bekalan kepada komuniti terpencil.
target_text: Aerial relief operations have successfully delivered 10 tonnes of supplies to isolated communities.

source_text: Penyelarasan antara pasukan tentera dan polis diperlukan untuk mengawal keselamatan di kawasan bencana.
target_text: Coordination between military and police teams is required to maintain security in the disaster area.

source_text: Pasukan kesihatan awam sedang menjalankan survei epidemiologi untuk mengenal pasti risiko penyakit.
target_text: The public health team is conducting an epidemiological survey to identify disease risks.

source_text: Pelan evakuasi komuniti perlu dikemas kini berdasarkan penilaian risiko semasa.
target_text: Community evacuation plans must be updated based on the current risk assessment.

source_text: Pasukan sukarelawan NGO sedang membantu dalam pengurusan kem pemindahan di kawasan selatan.
target_text: NGO volunteer teams are assisting in the management of evacuation camps in the southern area.

source_text: Laporan penilaian keperluan menunjukkan kekurangan ubat-ubatan kritikal di tiga hospital daerah.
target_text: The needs assessment report shows a shortage of critical medications at three district hospitals.

source_text: Pasukan penyelamat mendapati 5 mangsa masih hidup selepas 72 jam kejadian gempa bumi.
target_text: The rescue team found 5 survivors still alive 72 hours after the earthquake.

source_text: Operasi penuaian air banjir menggunakan pam besar sedang dijalankan di kawasan perumahan.
target_text: Floodwater drainage operations using heavy pumps are underway in residential areas.

source_text: Pasukan perubatan hadapan sedang merawat lebih 200 pesakit sehari di hospital lapangan.
target_text: The forward medical team is treating more than 200 patients daily at the field hospital.

source_text: Penerbangan kargo kecemasan telah diluluskan untuk menghantar peralatan penjana elektrik ke kawasan terlibat.
target_text: Emergency cargo flights have been approved to deliver electrical generator equipment to the affected area.

source_text: Pasukan koordinasi bersama ASEAN-ERAT sedang membantu dalam pengumpulan dan analisis data bencana.
target_text: The ASEAN-ERAT joint coordination team is assisting in the collection and analysis of disaster data.

source_text: Kemudahan sanitasi sementara sedang dipasang di seluruh kem pemindahan untuk mencegah penyakit.
target_text: Temporary sanitation facilities are being installed throughout the evacuation camp to prevent disease.

source_text: Pasukan pembangunan semula masyarakat sedang menilai keperluan jangka panjang komuniti terjejas.
target_text: The community reconstruction team is assessing the long-term needs of affected communities.

source_text: Pengangkutan mangsa kecemasan menggunakan ambulans udara sedang dilakukan oleh pasukan tentera udara.
target_text: Air ambulance transport of emergency casualties is being conducted by the air force team.

source_text: Maklumat terkini mengenai operasi bencana disebarkan melalui sistem amaran awam.
target_text: The latest information on disaster operations is being disseminated through the public warning system.

source_text: Pasukan pengurusan jenazah sedang menguruskan proses pengecaman dan pengkebumian mangsa bencana.
target_text: The remains management team is handling the identification and burial process for disaster victims.

source_text: Operasi pemindahan keluar bagi 3,000 penduduk kawasan pantai dijangka selesai dalam masa 6 jam.
target_text: Evacuation operations for 3,000 coastal residents are expected to be completed within 6 hours.

source_text: Pasukan HAZMAT sedang membersihkan tumpahan bahan kimia berbahaya ekoran kemalangan industri.
target_text: The HAZMAT team is cleaning up a hazardous chemical spill following an industrial accident.

source_text: Latihan respons bencana bersama antara Malaysia dan Indonesia akan diadakan bulan hadapan.
target_text: A joint disaster response exercise between Malaysia and Indonesia will be held next month.

source_text: Pos kawalan lalu lintas telah didirikan untuk mengawal pergerakan kenderaan ke kawasan bencana.
target_text: Traffic control posts have been established to regulate vehicle movement to the disaster area.

source_text: Pasukan pembangunan kapasiti sedang melatih anggota komuniti tempatan dalam kemahiran pertolongan cemas.
target_text: The capacity building team is training local community members in first aid skills.

source_text: Sistem pengurusan maklumat kemanusiaan sedang digunakan untuk menyelaraskan respons pelbagai agensi.
target_text: The humanitarian information management system is being used to coordinate multi-agency responses.

source_text: Pasukan bomba sedang memadamkan kebakaran di kawasan yang terlibat dalam bencana banjir.
target_text: The fire brigade is extinguishing fires in areas affected by the flood disaster.

source_text: Operasi pembersihan kawasan pasca bencana akan melibatkan lebih 1,000 anggota sukarelawan.
target_text: Post-disaster area clearance operations will involve more than 1,000 volunteer personnel.

source_text: Pasukan teknikal sedang membaiki sistem bekalan air awam yang rosak akibat tanah runtuh.
target_text: The technical team is repairing the public water supply system damaged by the landslide.

source_text: Pengurusan rantaian bekalan kemanusiaan memerlukan sistem penjejakan yang telus dan boleh dipercayai.
target_text: Humanitarian supply chain management requires a transparent and reliable tracking system.

source_text: Pasukan penyelidik sedang menganalisis punca bencana untuk mencegah kejadian serupa pada masa hadapan.
target_text: The research team is analysing the cause of the disaster to prevent similar incidents in the future.

source_text: Operasi pemindahan aset kritikal negara dari kawasan banjir sedang dijalankan oleh pasukan khas.
target_text: Operations to evacuate critical national assets from the flood area are being carried out by a special team.

source_text: Pasukan tindak balas kecemasan sedang menyelaraskan bantuan kepada mangsa gempa bumi di wilayah utara.
target_text: The emergency response team is coordinating assistance for earthquake victims in the northern region.

source_text: Bekalan bahan api untuk penjana elektrik perlu ditambah setiap 48 jam untuk kesinambungan operasi.
target_text: Fuel supplies for electric generators must be replenished every 48 hours for operational continuity.

source_text: Pasukan sokongan psikologi sedang memberikan khidmat kaunseling kepada anggota penyelamat yang tertekan.
target_text: The psychological support team is providing counselling services to stressed rescue personnel.

source_text: Infrastruktur kesihatan di kawasan bencana perlu dipulihkan sebelum operasi bantuan dapat dikurangkan.
target_text: Health infrastructure in the disaster area must be restored before relief operations can be scaled down.

source_text: Pasukan pengawasan pantai sedang memantau kawasan laut bagi mengesan mangsa yang hilang.
target_text: The coastal surveillance team is monitoring the maritime area to detect missing victims.

source_text: Protokol pertukaran maklumat antara agensi perlu dipatuhi semasa operasi bencana berskala besar.
target_text: Information exchange protocols between agencies must be followed during large-scale disaster operations.

source_text: Pasukan logistik sedang menyediakan manifes kargo untuk semua penghantaran bekalan bantuan kemanusiaan.

target_text: Evacuation camp upgrade operations are underway to improve victim comfort and safety.

target_text: The rescue team requires replacement of damaged equipment before continuing operations.

source_text: Koordinasi antara pasukan darat dan udara memerlukan frekuensi radio yang diselaraskan.

target_text: Victim search activities in the landslide area continue despite facing extreme weather challenges.

source_text: Pasukan perubatan kecemasan sedang menguruskan kes trauma kepala yang kritikal di hospital lapangan.

source_text: Operasi SAR malam menggunakan peralatan penglihatan malam dan dron berterma sedang dijalankan.

source_text: Pasukan kebajikan kanak-kanak sedang memastikan perlindungan dan keselamatan kanak-kanak di kem.
target_text: The child welfare team is ensuring the protection and safety of children at the camp.

source_text: Penghantaran konvoi bantuan kemanusiaan telah berjaya melalui laluan alternatif yang dikenal pasti.

source_text: Prosedur operasi standard untuk pengurusan bencana perlu dikaji semula selepas setiap operasi besar.
target_text: Standard operating procedures for disaster management must be reviewed after every major operation.

source_text: Pasukan tindak balas kecemasan nasional berada dalam keadaan berjaga dan sedia untuk digerakkan.
target_text: The national emergency response team is on standby and ready for deployment.

source_text: Helikopter penyelamat sedang menghantar tali hayat dan peralatan kepada mangsa yang terperangkap di bumbung.
target_text: Rescue helicopters are delivering lifelines and equipment to victims trapped on rooftops.

source_text: Agensi kemanusiaan memerlukan akses tanpa halangan ke kawasan bencana untuk menjalankan operasi bantuan.
target_text: Humanitarian agencies require unhindered access to the disaster area to conduct relief operations.

source_text: Pasukan teknikal sedang memasang sistem pemantauan banjir masa nyata di sepanjang sungai utama.
target_text: The technical team is installing a real-time flood monitoring system along the main rivers.

source_text: Pemindahan haiwan ternakan dari kawasan banjir juga merupakan sebahagian daripada operasi kecemasan.
target_text: Evacuation of livestock from flood areas is also part of the emergency operation.

source_text: Pasukan pengurusan bencana sedang menyelaraskan respons pelbagai peringkat dari pusat ke lapangan.
target_text: The disaster management team is coordinating a multi-level response from the centre to the field.

source_text: Kumpulan penyelarasan kluster kemanusiaan sedang menentukan jurang bantuan yang perlu diisi.
target_text: The humanitarian cluster coordination group is determining assistance gaps that need to be filled.

source_text: Pelan peralihan dari fasa tindak balas ke fasa pemulihan perlu disediakan sebelum operasi berakhir.
target_text: A transition plan from the response phase to the recovery phase must be prepared before operations end.

source_text: Pasukan kemanusiaan sedang berkolaborasi dengan komuniti tempatan untuk memastikan bantuan yang sesuai budaya.
target_text: Humanitarian teams are collaborating with local communities to ensure culturally appropriate assistance.

source_text: Operasi bersama tentera dan sivil memerlukan protokol peraturan interaksi yang jelas.
target_text: Joint military and civilian operations require clear rules of engagement protocols.

source_text: Pemantauan dan penilaian berterusan operasi bantuan diperlukan untuk memastikan keberkesanan.
target_text: Continuous monitoring and evaluation of relief operations is required to ensure effectiveness.

source_text: Pasukan SAR sedang menggunakan kaedah pencarian berangkai untuk meliput kawasan yang lebih luas.
target_text: The SAR team is using systematic search methods to cover a wider area.

source_text: Bantuan kemanusiaan perlu diagihkan tanpa diskriminasi berdasarkan kaum, agama atau politik.
target_text: Humanitarian assistance must be distributed without discrimination based on race, religion, or politics.

source_text: Pasukan penyelamat sedang menyelamatkan mangsa yang terperangkap dalam kenderaan akibat banjir kilat.
target_text: The rescue team is extracting victims trapped in vehicles due to flash flooding.

source_text: Operasi bantuan bencana memerlukan mekanisme aduan yang boleh diakses oleh semua mangsa.
target_text: Disaster relief operations require a complaints mechanism accessible to all victims.

source_text: Pasukan respons kecemasan telah menubuhkan zon pementasan untuk mengurus pergerakan anggota dan kenderaan.
target_text: The emergency response team has established a staging area to manage personnel and vehicle movement.

source_text: Laporan akhir operasi bantuan perlu merangkumi analisis jurang, pelajaran dipetik dan cadangan penambahbaikan.
target_text: The final relief operation report must include a gap analysis, lessons learned, and improvement recommendations.

source_text: Pasukan penyelamat sedang beroperasi dalam keadaan berbahaya di kawasan yang berisiko tanah runtuh susulan.
target_text: The rescue team is operating in dangerous conditions in areas at risk of secondary landslides.

source_text: Jawatankuasa pengurusan bencana negeri sedang mempengerusikan mesyuarat operasi setiap dua jam.
target_text: The state disaster management committee is chairing an operations meeting every two hours.

source_text: Pergerakan konvoi bantuan kemanusiaan perlu dipantau menggunakan sistem penjejakan GPS masa nyata.
target_text: Humanitarian aid convoy movements must be monitored using a real-time GPS tracking system.

source_text: Pasukan perubatan sedang menjalankan kempen kesedaran kebersihan di kem pemindahan.
target_text: The medical team is conducting hygiene awareness campaigns at the evacuation camp.

source_text: Kerajaan telah mengisytiharkan kawasan bencana sebagai zon bencana nasional bagi membolehkan lebih banyak sumber digunakan.
target_text: The government has declared the disaster area a national disaster zone to enable more resources to be mobilised.

source_text: Pasukan integrasi awam-tentera sedang berkoordinasi untuk mengelakkan pertindihan dalam operasi bantuan.
target_text: The civil-military integration team is coordinating to avoid duplication in relief operations.

source_text: Analisis data bencana menunjukkan kawasan barat daya paling teruk terjejas dan memerlukan keutamaan bantuan.
target_text: Disaster data analysis shows the southwest area is most severely affected and requires priority assistance.

source_text: Pasukan sokongan logistik sedang menyediakan perkhidmatan penyelenggaraan kenderaan untuk armada operasi.
target_text: The logistics support team is providing vehicle maintenance services for the operational fleet.

source_text: Mesyuarat penyelarasan kluster air, sanitasi dan kebersihan diadakan setiap hari untuk menilai keperluan.
target_text: Water, sanitation, and hygiene cluster coordination meetings are held daily to assess needs.

source_text: Pasukan perubatan lapangan sedang menguruskan kes patah tulang dan luka parah di hospital medan.
target_text: The field medical team is managing fracture and serious wound cases at the field hospital.

source_text: 救灾指挥部已启动24小时值班制度，确保紧急情况能得到即时响应。
target_text: The disaster relief command post has activated a 24-hour duty roster to ensure immediate response to emergencies.

source_text: 工程队正在评估受损堤坝的安全状况，以决定是否需要紧急加固。
target_text: The engineering team is assessing the safety of damaged levees to determine whether emergency reinforcement is required.

source_text: 人道主义组织正在建立受益人信息管理系统，确保援助物资精准到达目标人群。
target_text: Humanitarian organisations are establishing a beneficiary information management system to ensure aid supplies reach target populations accurately.

source_text: 化学品泄漏事故响应队已携带专业防护装备抵达现场，开始进行隔离和清理作业。
target_text: The chemical spill response team has arrived on site with specialist protective equipment and begun isolation and cleanup operations.

source_text: 灾区学校已恢复正常教学秩序，流离失所的学生通过远程教育继续学习。
target_text: Schools in the disaster area have resumed normal teaching order; displaced students continue learning via distance education.

source_text: 水上救援队正在使用声纳设备搜寻洪水中失踪人员的下落。
target_text: The water rescue team is using sonar equipment to search for the whereabouts of persons missing in the floodwaters.

source_text: 国际救援队伍须接受东道国安全简报后方可进入灾区开展工作。
target_text: International rescue teams must receive a host nation security briefing before entering the disaster area to begin operations.

source_text: 物资分发点须设立排队管理机制，防止踩踏事故和不公平分配现象发生。
target_text: Supply distribution points must establish queue management mechanisms to prevent stampedes and unfair distribution.

source_text: 救援行动结束后须对所有参与救援的志愿者进行心理健康评估。
target_text: After relief operations conclude, a mental health assessment must be conducted for all participating volunteers.

source_text: 地质灾害专家正在评估山区地质稳定性，以确定是否存在二次滑坡风险。
target_text: Geological hazard experts are assessing the geological stability of the mountain area to determine whether secondary landslide risks exist.

source_text: 灾区临时道路已由工兵部队铺设完毕，重型救援装备可顺利通行。
target_text: Temporary roads in the disaster area have been laid by the engineer corps; heavy rescue equipment can now pass through smoothly.

source_text: 由于灾情持续扩大，国家已向联合国提出正式援助申请。
target_text: Due to the continued expansion of the disaster, the country has submitted a formal assistance request to the United Nations.

source_text: 野外搜救队须在每次出发前向指挥部报告预计搜索路线和返回时间。
target_text: Field search and rescue teams must report their planned search routes and return times to the command post before each departure.

source_text: 灾区废水处理设施受损，存在粪口传播疾病暴发风险，需立即采取应对措施。
target_text: Wastewater treatment facilities in the disaster area are damaged, posing a risk of faecal-oral disease outbreaks; immediate countermeasures are required.

source_text: 跨国联合救灾演练的总结报告已提交，其中包含改进双边协调机制的具体建议。
target_text: The after-action report for the multinational joint disaster relief exercise has been submitted, containing specific recommendations for improving bilateral coordination mechanisms.

source_text: 灾情信息共享平台已上线，各救援机构可实时获取灾情数据和资源分布信息。
target_text: The disaster information sharing platform is now online; all relief agencies can access real-time disaster data and resource distribution information.

source_text: 联合医疗队正在灾区建立转诊网络，确保重症患者能获得专科救治。
target_text: The joint medical team is establishing a referral network in the disaster area to ensure critically ill patients receive specialist treatment.

source_text: 人道主义援助行动的资金使用须定期向捐助方提交透明的财务报告。
target_text: Financial use in humanitarian assistance operations must be reported to donors through regular transparent financial reports.

source_text: 救灾一线人员的个人防护装备储备不足，需紧急补充以确保作业安全。
target_text: Personal protective equipment reserves for frontline disaster relief personnel are insufficient; urgent replenishment is needed to ensure operational safety.

source_text: 受灾地区医院手术室已超负荷运转，需从周边省份紧急调派外科医生支援。
target_text: Hospital operating theatres in the disaster area are overloaded; surgeons from surrounding provinces need to be urgently dispatched for support.

source_text: 灾区通信恢复工作已完成60%，预计24小时内可实现全区覆盖。
target_text: Communications restoration work in the disaster area is 60% complete; full coverage is expected within 24 hours.

source_text: 救援物资接收核查机制须建立，防止物资在分发过程中出现损耗和挪用。
target_text: A relief supply receipt verification mechanism must be established to prevent loss and misappropriation during distribution.

source_text: 紧急救灾融资机制已触发，首批资金将在48小时内划拨至灾区救援账户。
target_text: The emergency disaster financing mechanism has been triggered; the first tranche of funds will be transferred to the disaster area relief account within 48 hours.

source_text: 救援行动中的性别主流化要求确保女性受灾者在援助决策中有平等发言权。
target_text: Gender mainstreaming in relief operations requires ensuring that female disaster victims have equal voice in aid decision-making.

source_text: 搜救行动区域已根据最新航拍图像重新划定，以提高搜索效率。
target_text: SAR operational areas have been redrawn based on the latest aerial imagery to improve search efficiency.

source_text: 人道主义协调办公室已发布灾情快报，向国际社会通报最新救援进展。
target_text: The humanitarian coordination office has issued a disaster flash update, informing the international community of the latest relief progress.

source_text: 消防救援部门已在灾区建立移动指挥车，统一调度辖区内所有救援力量。
target_text: The fire and rescue department has established a mobile command vehicle in the disaster area to centrally dispatch all rescue forces in the jurisdiction.

source_text: 后勤保障体系须确保救援物资从集结地到灾区的全程冷链不中断。
target_text: The logistics support system must ensure uninterrupted cold chain for relief supplies from the staging area to the disaster zone.

source_text: 联合国人道事务协调厅正在协调集群响应机制，统筹各专项援助领域工作。
target_text: OCHA is coordinating the cluster response mechanism to integrate work across all specialised aid sectors.

source_text: 灾害风险评估结果显示，该地区每年发生百年一遇洪涝灾害的概率已大幅上升。
target_text: Disaster risk assessment results show that the probability of a once-in-a-century flood occurring annually in the region has increased significantly.

source_text: 救援人员在进入危险区域前须接受危险区域安全与生存培训。
target_text: Relief personnel must receive hazardous area safety and survival training before entering dangerous zones.

source_text: 灾区重建工作须遵循重建更好原则，将减灾措施纳入基础设施重建方案。
target_text: Reconstruction work in the disaster area must follow the build back better principle, incorporating disaster risk reduction measures into infrastructure rebuilding plans.

source_text: 非粮食物品分发须与粮食援助协同进行，确保受灾群众的综合生活需求得到满足。
target_text: Non-food item distribution must be coordinated with food assistance to ensure the comprehensive livelihood needs of disaster victims are met.

source_text: 应急医疗队的轮换周期为两周，以防止救援人员因长期高强度工作出现职业耗竭。
target_text: Emergency medical team rotation cycles are two weeks to prevent relief personnel from experiencing professional burnout due to prolonged high-intensity work.

target_text: Rescue helicopters have established temporary resupply points in the mountain area to ensure fuel and supply support for highland SAR operations.

source_text: 受灾地区供电恢复工作已按优先顺序推进，医院和应急指挥中心优先恢复供电。
target_text: Power restoration work in the disaster area is progressing according to priority order, with hospitals and emergency command centres restored first.

source_text: 联合评估报告建议在灾害高风险区建立社区预警网络，以提升基层减灾能力。
target_text: The joint assessment report recommends establishing community early warning networks in high disaster-risk areas to enhance grassroots disaster risk reduction capacity.

source_text: 灾区粮食援助须采用现金或代金券方式，以支持当地市场恢复和受灾群众自主选择。
target_text: Food assistance in disaster areas should use cash or voucher modalities to support local market recovery and beneficiary choice.

source_text: 搜救任务结束后，所有现场证据须按规定保存，以供事后调查和责任认定使用。
target_text: After SAR missions are completed, all on-site evidence must be preserved according to regulations for subsequent investigation and accountability purposes.

source_text: 跨部门协调会须建立统一的行动图和信息共享机制，避免行动冲突和资源浪费。
target_text: Inter-departmental coordination meetings must establish a unified operational picture and information sharing mechanism to avoid operational conflicts and resource waste.

source_text: 灾害响应人员必须定期接受心理健康检查，以确保其在高压环境下保持工作能力。
target_text: Disaster response personnel must undergo regular mental health checks to ensure they maintain work capacity in high-pressure environments.

source_text: 城市搜救行动须与结构工程师紧密协作，以评估建筑安全和制定安全进入方案。
target_text: Urban search and rescue operations must work closely with structural engineers to assess building safety and develop safe entry plans.

source_text: 人道主义物流协调中心正在优化运输路线，以降低救援物资运输成本和时间。
target_text: The humanitarian logistics coordination centre is optimising transport routes to reduce the cost and time of relief supply transportation.

source_text: 受损电信基础设施的恢复须优先保障应急通信需求，其次再考虑商业用户恢复。
target_text: Restoration of damaged telecommunications infrastructure must prioritise emergency communication needs before considering commercial user restoration.

source_text: 国际人道主义援助物资的清关须通过专门的绿色通道处理，以加快物资抵达速度。
target_text: Customs clearance for international humanitarian aid supplies must be processed through a dedicated green channel to accelerate delivery speed.

source_text: 救灾志愿者培训计划已在各省市启动，旨在建立一支训练有素的预备救援力量。
target_text: Disaster relief volunteer training programmes have been launched across provinces and cities, aimed at building a well-trained reserve rescue force.

source_text: 灾后社区恢复力评估须包括社会凝聚力、经济复原力和生态系统恢复等多个维度。
target_text: Post-disaster community resilience assessments must encompass multiple dimensions including social cohesion, economic resilience, and ecosystem recovery.

source_text: 人道主义行动中的问责机制须对受灾群众负责，而不仅仅对捐助方负责。
target_text: Accountability mechanisms in humanitarian operations must be accountable to disaster victims, not just to donors.

source_text: 搜救犬队已完成对重点废墟区域的气味侦测，标记出三处可能有生命迹象的位置。
target_text: The search dog team has completed scent detection in key rubble areas, marking three locations with possible signs of life.

source_text: 救援行动中发现的未爆弹药须立即向爆炸物处理部门报告，并设立安全隔离区。
target_text: Unexploded ordnance discovered during relief operations must be immediately reported to the explosive ordnance disposal unit, and a safety exclusion zone established.

source_text: 国家灾害管理局正在与地方政府合作，共同制定灾后恢复和重建综合行动计划。
target_text: The National Disaster Management Agency is working with local governments to jointly develop a comprehensive post-disaster recovery and reconstruction action plan.

source_text: 救援行动中须特别关注残疾人、老年人和独居者等高风险群体的需求和保护。
target_text: Special attention must be given during relief operations to the needs and protection of high-risk groups including persons with disabilities, the elderly, and those living alone.

source_text: 灾区水质检测结果显示大肠杆菌超标，需立即启动应急供水和净水片发放。
target_text: Water quality test results in the disaster area show E. coli exceeding safe limits; emergency water supply and water purification tablet distribution must begin immediately.

source_text: 联合救援行动的指挥控制须明确各方权责，避免多头指挥影响行动效率。
target_text: Command and control in joint relief operations must clearly define the responsibilities of all parties to avoid overlapping command structures affecting operational efficiency.

source_text: 灾区重建规划须充分考虑气候变化因素，确保新建设施具备应对未来极端天气的能力。
target_text: Disaster area reconstruction planning must fully consider climate change factors to ensure new facilities have the capacity to cope with future extreme weather events.

source_text: 医疗队在灾区发现多例疑似霍乱病例，已启动隔离和流行病学调查程序。
target_text: The medical team has found multiple suspected cholera cases in the disaster area and has initiated isolation and epidemiological investigation procedures.

source_text: 救援物资的最后一公里配送须依靠社区志愿者网络完成，以覆盖偏远受灾点。
target_text: Last-mile delivery of relief supplies must rely on community volunteer networks to reach remote disaster points.

source_text: 灾害响应协调机制须定期演练，以确保各部门在真实灾情中能够无缝协作。
target_text: Disaster response coordination mechanisms must be regularly exercised to ensure all departments can collaborate seamlessly in a real disaster.

source_text: 前方指挥所须配备备用通信设备，确保主通信系统故障时指挥链不中断。
target_text: The forward command post must be equipped with backup communication equipment to ensure the command chain is not interrupted if the primary system fails.

source_text: 空投物资的精准投送须使用GPS引导系统，以确保物资落在指定接收区域内。
target_text: Precision delivery of airdropped supplies must use GPS guidance systems to ensure supplies land within the designated receiving area.

source_text: 灾害医学专家正在为前线救援人员提供现场外科和急救技术的强化培训。
target_text: Disaster medicine experts are providing frontline rescue personnel with intensive training in field surgery and emergency first aid techniques.

source_text: 跨境人道主义援助须遵守接受国的国家主权原则和相关法律法规要求。
target_text: Cross-border humanitarian assistance must respect the receiving country's national sovereignty principles and comply with relevant legal and regulatory requirements.

source_text: 救援行动中的媒体管理须平衡信息透明度与受灾群众隐私保护之间的关系。
target_text: Media management in relief operations must balance information transparency with the protection of disaster victims' privacy.

source_text: 灾后心理健康支持计划须覆盖受灾群众、救援人员及遇难者家属三类群体。
target_text: Post-disaster mental health support programmes must cover three groups: disaster victims, relief personnel, and families of the deceased.

source_text: 受灾地区的粮食价格监测显示市场出现哄抬物价现象，需政府介入稳定市场。
target_text: Food price monitoring in disaster areas shows price gouging occurring in the market; government intervention is needed to stabilise the market.

source_text: 救灾船只须配备完整的航行安全设备和救生装置，方可进入危险水域执行任务。
target_text: Disaster relief vessels must be equipped with complete navigation safety equipment and life-saving devices before entering hazardous waters to carry out missions.

source_text: 灾情评估数据须经过独立核实后方可纳入官方报告，以确保数据准确性。
target_text: Disaster assessment data must undergo independent verification before being included in official reports to ensure data accuracy.

source_text: 救援行动中的环境影响须得到评估，确保救灾活动不造成额外的生态破坏。
target_text: Environmental impacts during relief operations must be assessed to ensure relief activities do not cause additional ecological damage.

source_text: 灾区电信运营商须优先为应急服务提供通信保障，并开放免费紧急呼叫服务。
target_text: Telecommunications operators in the disaster area must prioritise communication support for emergency services and open free emergency calling services.

source_text: 联合搜救行动须建立统一的伤亡登记系统，避免重复统计和漏报现象发生。
target_text: Joint SAR operations must establish a unified casualty registration system to avoid duplicate counting and under-reporting.

source_text: Pasukan teknikal sedang memulihkan bekalan elektrik ke hospital dan pusat arahan operasi.
target_text: The technical team is restoring electricity supply to hospitals and operations command centres.

source_text: Laporan sitrep harian daripada semua kluster kemanusiaan perlu dikumpul oleh penyelaras utama.
target_text: Daily sitrep reports from all humanitarian clusters must be compiled by the lead coordinator.

source_text: Pasukan CERT komuniti telah diaktifkan untuk membantu operasi cari dan selamat di peringkat akar umbi.
target_text: Community CERT teams have been activated to assist search and rescue operations at the grassroots level.

source_text: Operasi pembersihan kawasan perumahan terjejas dijangka mengambil masa 14 hari untuk diselesaikan.
target_text: Clearance operations in affected residential areas are expected to take 14 days to complete.

source_text: Pasukan pembangunan keupayaan sedang menjalankan latihan pengurusan bencana untuk pegawai daerah.
target_text: The capacity building team is conducting disaster management training for district officers.

source_text: Pengagihan bantuan tunai kepada mangsa bencana dilaksanakan melalui sistem pembayaran digital kerajaan.
target_text: Cash assistance distribution to disaster victims is implemented through the government's digital payment system.

source_text: Pasukan kejuruteraan sedang membina sistem saliran sementara untuk mencegah banjir susulan.
target_text: The engineering team is constructing a temporary drainage system to prevent secondary flooding.

source_text: Pelan respons bencana kebangsaan sedang dikaji semula berdasarkan pengalaman operasi terkini.
target_text: The national disaster response plan is being reviewed based on experience from recent operations.

source_text: Pasukan penyelamat laut sedang menggunakan sonar untuk mengesan lokasi bot yang karam.
target_text: The maritime rescue team is using sonar to detect the location of the capsized boat.

source_text: Semua agensi kemanusiaan perlu menyerahkan laporan 5W (siapa, apa, di mana, bila, berapa) kepada penyelaras.
target_text: All humanitarian agencies must submit 5W (who, what, where, when, how many) reports to the coordinator.

source_text: Pasukan komunikasi awam sedang menyebarkan maklumat tentang laluan evakuasi selamat melalui radio.
target_text: The public communications team is disseminating information on safe evacuation routes via radio.

source_text: Operasi bersama memerlukan perjanjian bertulis mengenai pembahagian tanggungjawab antara agensi.
target_text: Joint operations require a written agreement on the division of responsibilities between agencies.

source_text: Pasukan penyelidik sedang mendokumentasikan amalan terbaik dalam operasi bantuan untuk rujukan masa hadapan.
target_text: The research team is documenting best practices in relief operations for future reference.

source_text: Kluster perlindungan sedang mengenal pasti kes keganasan berasaskan gender di kalangan mangsa bencana.
target_text: The protection cluster is identifying cases of gender-based violence among disaster victims.

source_text: Pasukan kesihatan mental sedang melatih pekerja kemanusiaan dalam teknik pertolongan cemas psikologi.
target_text: The mental health team is training humanitarian workers in psychological first aid techniques.

source_text: Penyelarasan dengan pihak berkuasa tempatan diperlukan sebelum memulakan sebarang aktiviti pembangunan semula.
target_text: Coordination with local authorities is required before commencing any reconstruction activities.

source_text: Pasukan pemantauan sedang menilai kualiti air sungai untuk mengesan pencemaran akibat bencana industri.
target_text: The monitoring team is assessing river water quality to detect contamination from the industrial disaster.

source_text: Sistem pengurusan kem telah didigitalkan untuk membolehkan pendaftaran dan pengagihan bantuan yang lebih cekap.
target_text: The camp management system has been digitised to enable more efficient registration and aid distribution.

source_text: Pasukan perubatan lapangan sedang menjalankan pemeriksaan kesihatan berkala ke atas semua penghuni kem.
target_text: The field medical team is conducting regular health screenings for all camp residents.

source_text: Protokol penyerahan tanggungjawab antara pasukan luar negara dan agensi tempatan perlu disediakan.
target_text: A handover protocol between foreign teams and local agencies must be prepared.

source_text: Operasi pemulihan mata pencarian mangsa bencana sedang dilaksanakan melalui program latihan vokasional.
target_text: Livelihood recovery operations for disaster victims are being implemented through vocational training programmes.

source_text: Pasukan keselamatan makanan sedang memantau bekalan makanan di kem untuk mengelak keracunan.
target_text: The food safety team is monitoring food supplies at the camp to prevent poisoning.

source_text: Dokumen pengesahan keperluan bantuan perlu disiapkan sebelum permohonan bantuan antarabangsa dikemukakan.
target_text: Assistance needs verification documents must be prepared before international aid requests are submitted.

source_text: Pasukan pengurusan bencana sedang membangunkan pangkalan data mangsa bencana yang bersepadu.
target_text: The disaster management team is developing an integrated disaster victim database.

source_text: Semua keputusan operasi utama perlu didokumenkan dalam buku log operasi yang boleh diaudit.
target_text: All major operational decisions must be documented in an auditable operations log book.

source_text: Pasukan penilaian pascabencana sedang mengumpul maklumat untuk laporan akhir kesan bencana.
target_text: The post-disaster assessment team is gathering information for the final disaster impact report.

source_text: Keperluan khas wanita hamil dan ibu menyusu di kem perlu dipenuhi melalui kit kesihatan ibu.
target_text: The special needs of pregnant women and nursing mothers at the camp must be met through maternal health kits.

source_text: Pasukan koordinasi maklumat bencana sedang menyelaraskan laporan daripada semua agensi terlibat.
target_text: The disaster information coordination team is consolidating reports from all involved agencies.

source_text: Latihan simulasi bencana peringkat kebangsaan akan diadakan untuk menguji kesiapsiagaan sistem respons.
target_text: A national-level disaster simulation exercise will be held to test the readiness of the response system.

source_text: Pasukan integrasi teknologi sedang menggunakan AI untuk menganalisis data bencana dan meramal keperluan.
target_text: The technology integration team is using AI to analyse disaster data and predict needs.

source_text: Semua anggota operasi perlu mempunyai kad pengenalan rasmi dan mendapat kebenaran memasuki kawasan bencana.
target_text: All operational personnel must have official identification cards and obtain authorisation to enter the disaster area.

source_text: Pasukan gerak balas bencana menggunakan sistem pengurusan insiden untuk mengurus sumber dengan berkesan.
target_text: The disaster response team is using an incident management system to effectively manage resources.

source_text: 灾害响应预算须按照人道主义援助支出透明度原则进行管理和披露。
target_text: Disaster response budgets must be managed and disclosed according to humanitarian aid expenditure transparency principles.

source_text: 救援行动中的数据保护须遵守相关法规，防止受灾群众个人信息被滥用。
target_text: Data protection during relief operations must comply with relevant regulations to prevent misuse of disaster victims' personal information.

source_text: Pasukan koordinasi bencana sedang mengemaskini peta operasi dengan maklumat terkini dari lapangan.
target_text: The disaster coordination team is updating the operational map with the latest information from the field.

source_text: Semua bekalan perubatan yang dihantar ke kawasan bencana perlu melalui pemeriksaan kualiti terlebih dahulu.
target_text: All medical supplies sent to the disaster area must undergo quality inspection beforehand.
